components.css: .ds-power-pair{display:flex;gap:24px;padding:16px;background:#17161c;} .ds-power{display:grid;place-items:center;width:88px;height:88px;border:2px solid #6441a5;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 44px #6441a5,0 4px 12px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);transition:box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);} .ds-power:hover{border-color:#7351b5;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 44px #7351b5,0 4px 12px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);} .ds-power:active{transform:scale(0.96);} .ds-power[aria-pressed="false"]{border-color:#6a6776;color:#a7a4b3;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 0 #6441a5,0 0 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0);} .ds-power[aria-pressed="false"]:hover{border-color:#a7a4b3;color:#ecebf1;} .ds-power:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #bba5ec;outline-offset:4px;} .ds-power svg{width:36px;height:36px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;}

components.css: .ds-setting{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:320px;padding:12px 16px;background:#17161c;color:#ecebf1;font:13px/1.45 system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Ubuntu,Cantarell,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;border-top:1px solid #2e2c37;border-bottom:1px solid #2e2c37;cursor:pointer;} .ds-setting-text{display:grid;flex:1;} .ds-hint{color:#a7a4b3;font-size:12px;} .ds-switch{appearance:none;position:relative;flex:none;width:36px;height:20px;margin:0;border-radius:10px;background:#6a6776;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);} .ds-switch::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#ecebf1;transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);} .ds-switch:checked{background:#6441a5;} .ds-switch:checked::after{transform:translateX(16px);} .ds-switch:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #bba5ec;outline-offset:2px;}

components.html:
# Purple Adblock diagnostic log
2026-11-21T13:37:00 INFO  breakStart kind=stitched
2026-11-21T13:42:40 WARN  stall      track=video seconds=2.3

narrative.overview:
Purple's surfaces are a small dark instrument opened over a playing stream, mostly at night. The popup answers one question, whether Purple is on for this channel, with one large round power button, and puts today's figures for that channel directly under it. Everything else (one switch row, the rate and report actions) sits below in quieter type. The system follows the ad-blocker popup standard set by uBlock Origin and by 7TV and BetterTTV, executed straight, at their level of craft.

The ground is a near-black with a slight violet cast. The logo's violet is the only brand colour and carries state: it fills the power button when Purple is on, and leaves a grey ring when off. Coral and amber appear only as signals inside the figures row. Type is the platform's own UI sans, because the popup loads nothing from the network; figures are tabular. Sections are divided by hairlines rather than boxed into cards. The export page reuses the same tokens at tab width, with a monospace log sheet.

The surfaces reject two looks, both confirmed by the maintainer: Twitch's own site chrome, and a settings form with no main state.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, a 320 px fixed-width popup; the export page caps content at 960 px.
One violet, used for state and the primary action, never for decoration.
One main control (the 88 px power button), one figures row, short switch list, actions at the foot.
System UI sans at 13 px body; tabular numerals for every number.
Hairline separators, an 8 px radius family, authored 2 px stroke icons.
One shared easing curve; state changes in 180 ms, hover in 160 ms; no motion under reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Violet means "Purple is acting" or "the main action". It is the only hue besides the two signals; no gradients, no second accent, no violet borders or backgrounds for decoration.

rules.name: The Signals Only Above Zero Rule
rules.body: Coral and amber colour a figure only when that figure is above zero. A zero stays in the neutral text colour; the signal colours never appear on labels, borders or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Dark Only Rule
rules.body: There is no light theme. The surfaces declare `color-scheme: dark` and open over Twitch at night.

rules.name: The Local Type Rule
rules.body: Only the platform's system stacks. The popup loads nothing from the network, so no web fonts, bundled or remote, are added to these surfaces.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number (version, today's figures, the log) uses tabular numerals so values do not shift as they change.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Titles, labels and buttons are sentence case at normal tracking. No uppercase labels and no letter-spaced small caps.

rules.name: The One Lifted Object Rule
rules.body: Only the power button casts a shadow. Buttons, inputs, the consent box and the log sheet stay flat.

dos: **Do** keep one main state per view and make it the largest object: the 88px power button on a channel, the single primary button elsewhere.
**Do** take colours only from the tokens; violet for state and the primary action, coral and amber only for a non-zero "got through" or "stalls" figure.
**Do** separate popup sections with 1px hairlines and full-width bands, insetting content 16px.
**Do** set every number in tabular figures and every label in sentence case.
**Do** draw new icons as inline SVG on the 24-unit grid with a 2px round stroke, 16px by default.
**Do** use the shared easing `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` with 160ms for hover and 180ms for state, and drop transitions under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** keep the 2px lavender focus outline on every focusable element.
donts: **Don't** borrow Twitch's site chrome or make the popup read as part of twitch.tv.
**Don't** build a view as a settings form without a main state at the top.
**Don't** add a second accent hue, gradients, or violet used as decoration.
**Don't** load web fonts or remote images; the surfaces stay network-free.
**Don't** add shadows to anything but the power button, or box popup sections into cards.
**Don't** add uppercase or letter-spaced labels above titles.
